name: motion-sfx-cues
title: SFX Cues on the Grid
description: Mỗi tiếng click, pop, thump, whoosh được đặt đúng khung đỉnh của chuyển động hoặc đúng phách đo được.sfx`.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Each motion's peak frame = the sound's onset (within +-1 frame; the kit puts the attack one frame after the picture). Demo: a 4 s beat ruler with cues click 0.5 s, pop 1.0, thump 2.0, whoosh 2.75, pop 3.5; at each cue a ring pulses 8 -> 28 px decaying e^(-8 t) (motion 120 ms easeOutExpo). Params: sounds (click / pop / thump / whoosh) · at: phách hoặc đỉnh. Each motion's peak frame is the sound's onset (within ±1 frame). In a Moworks film, write these as the app's sfx cues; this block only shows where they land.
